name: Windows VM
author: lef
description: Control Omarchy's Windows VM from the bar: connect without a password prompt, RDP that reconnects by itself, restart and shut down. Zero background cost: live CPU, memory, disk and network graphs are gathered only while the panel is open. Web console, shared folder, terminal and lazydocker shortcuts, optional keep-alive.

barWidget.description: Windows VM control and on-demand stats: click for the panel, right-click for the Windows desktop.
